grounding.anchor_4: Every factual atom entailed by visible same-scope sources; exact fields match; uncertainty and provenance preserved.
grounding.anchor_2: At least one material unsupported or stronger-than-source fact; automatic rejection regardless of prose.

task_completion.anchor_4: All applicable requested components, explicit constraints and output routing satisfied.
task_completion.anchor_2: Missing substantive section, question component, requirement or required user input.

job_relevance.anchor_4: Strongest supported content prioritized against actual posting requirements without keyword stuffing.
job_relevance.anchor_2: Generic or weak selection despite available relevant evidence.

specificity.anchor_4: Concrete role, contribution, context and supported result/purpose; qualitative impact accepted.
specificity.anchor_2: Vague duties or technology list without contribution/context where evidence permits it.

writing.anchor_4: Natural professional voice, strong precise verbs, readable syntax and accurate tense; no filler.
writing.anchor_2: Boilerplate, awkward repetition, generic flattery or inconsistent tense obscures substance.

structure_coherence.anchor_4: Ordered complete artifact; sections complement one another; chronology and terms consistent; minimal redundant events.
structure_coherence.anchor_2: Locally fluent fragments form an incomplete, repetitive or incoherent artifact.

uncertainty_handling.anchor_4: Material missing facts/preferences/conflicts identified precisely; optional omissions do not force unnecessary blocking.
uncertainty_handling.anchor_2: Unnecessary blocking or incomplete gap requests; any guessed material answer also fails grounding.

downstream_usability.anchor_4: Strict schema, directly renderable content, exact identifiable fields, actionable gap requests, no false ATS/accessibility guarantee.
downstream_usability.anchor_2: Requires substantive repair before renderer/application can use it.

scale.3: Professional and usable with minor optional edits
scale.4: Specific, concise, coherent and publication-ready content

task_specific_anchor_4: Classify and directly answer factual, behavioral, motivation, preference or eligibility questions.
Exact administrative facts and personal decisions require supplied data; absent material inputs produce specific USER_INPUT_REQUIRED questions.
Use supported situation/action/result detail only as useful, preserve same-event claims and satisfy exact word/character limits.
task_specific_anchor_2: A material failure of any task-specific anchor requires revision; unsupported facts fail regardless of stylistic quality.
